newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany says conditions for low rates still good.
newsitem.headline: Germany says conditions for low rates still good.

text.p: Despite the recent rise in interest rates in the United States, conditions for low interest rates are still favourable in Europe, a senior German finance ministry official said on Thursday.
Juergen Stark, state secretary in the finance ministry, also said European interest rate developments had been decoupled from the United States for some time now.
"The decoupling of U.S. interest rates is to be welcomed," Stark told reporters in Bonn.
He added there were also slight differences in interest rate developments in Europe as a result of the effects of varying macroeconomic data.
